dogecoin.text: @AaronUncensored @julianhosp @cakedefi @elonmusk True, because there are very few $DOGE development going on, most are $DOGE speculators waiting for the next tweet from Elon. $DOGE prob has the largest trade volume to full node ratio amongst the major blockchains that I've seen.
